// A uniformly sampled time series: sample i occurs at Start plus i times
// SamplePeriod. Values are in Unit.
type TimeSeries
    implements ITimeSampled
{
    Start: Instant;
    SamplePeriod: Duration;
    Values: Array<Number>;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
}
